summary: Milwaukee County's Park Commission testified at the March 25, 1969 Location Public Hearing, indicating that the proposed Airport Spur facility did not interfere with any existing or proposed park development. Their position was neutral-to-supportive, raising no objections to the project on park-related grounds.
